candidates.buyer: Licensed crewing and manning agents in Funafuti; possibly TOSU and Ministry of Labour
candidates.category: 31. Seafarer recruitment, certification and placement / 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
candidates.existing: None found for Tuvalu agents. Ship Registry runs Tuvalu On-line Registry (vessels only); SPC Neptune seafarer database exists regionally (adoption in Tuvalu unclear).
candidates.known_note: Different buyer (crewing agents, not vessel operators) and different duty (recruitment licensing, contracts, insurance) from the fisheries licence and logsheet tool K01.
candidates.name: C1 Crewing agent / seafarer recruitment compliance tool (Tuvalu-flagged fishing crew and overseas merchant seafarers)
candidates.trigger: Labour and Employment Relations Act 2017 ss9-10 (recruitment agents); STCW regulations requiring licensed private seafarer recruitment with compensation insurance; Ship Registry MC 08/2012 (MLC recruitment); 2025 safe fishing and crew employment workshop on crew recruitment for Tuvalu-flagged seine vessels
candidates.trigger_note: Not scored higher because agent count is likely under 10 and market tiny.
candidates.unchecked: Number of crewing agents; whether a licence register exists; current licence fees and renewal terms; White List status; whether TOSU or the Ministry already keeps a digital register. Competitor search (seafarer database Tuvalu) found nothing local.

candidates.buyer: Small private employers (shops, guest houses, church bodies, fishing companies)
candidates.category: 1. Household employers / 32. Provident fund employer duties
candidates.existing: Nothing found; seems paper-based. Generic payroll guides only.
candidates.name: C2 TNPF employer registration and monthly contribution return helper
candidates.trigger: Provident Fund (Registration) Regulations: register within 7 days of first employee; Contributions Regulations: monthly contribution returns and payment statements with approved forms and name and membership number per employee
candidates.unchecked: Number of private employers; actual TNPF forms and rate; whether TNPF has any portal. Total private payrolls in Tuvalu are very small.

candidates.buyer: Small shops and traders (turnover under or around 100k)
candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors / 33. Consumption tax and presumptive tax
candidates.name: C3 Consumption tax and presumptive tax return helper for small traders
candidates.trigger: Consumption Tax Act 2008 (quarterly periods, registration over about 100k per old form); Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2017 presumptive tax (annual under 50k, quarterly 50k-100k, Schedule 9)
candidates.unchecked: Current thresholds and rates; filing channel; number of registrants. Presumptive tax is simple so little for software to do.

candidates.buyer: Island co-operative societies and the Registrar of Co-operatives
candidates.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
candidates.name: C4 Island co-operative society annual accounts and audit helper
candidates.trigger: Co-operative Societies Act Cap 40.20 and Regulations (annual accounts and report, audit and supervision fund, register of members)
candidates.unchecked: How many societies are active; whether returns are enforced. Text of Part 6 audit sections not read.

candidates.buyer: Seafarers and their agents; TMTI; TOSU
candidates.existing: Bahamas and Liberia digital seafarer record books are for other flags; nothing found for Tuvalu seafarers.
candidates.name: C5 Seafarer qualification and medical certificate expiry tracker (for TMTI, TOSU, agents)
candidates.trigger: STCW COE endorsement validity, medicals every 2 years (Ship Registry circular), ADB finding that Tuvalu paper records could not identify seafarers needing upgrades
candidates.unchecked: Whether Tuvalu has adopted SPC Neptune database; buyer is mostly state or union (outside scope if it is the state's own system); willingness to pay by individual seafarers.

candidates.buyer: Owners of small passenger and trading vessels
candidates.evidence: https://pacliirms.paclii.org/tv/legis/consol_act_2022/lsa4812186.pdf ; https://tvship.com/Resources/Downloads/Regulations/Non-Convention regulations for vessels of more than 12 metres in length, Edition 1 July 2024.pdf
candidates.name: C6 Inter-island and lagoon vessel seaworthiness certificate tracker
candidates.trigger: Lagoon Shipping Act (2022 rev.) certificate of seaworthiness, passenger limit, certificated officers; Merchant Shipping (Safety) Regulations 2008 local safety certificate; Non-Convention regulations for vessels over 12 m (July 2024 edition)
candidates.unchecked: Number of private small-vessel owners (many ferries are government-owned); survey frequency.

candidates.existing: TANGO provides training, no software found.
candidates.name: C7 NGO registrar compliance helper
candidates.trigger: Incorporation of Non-Governmental Organizations Act Cap 32.03 (registration, Registrar inspection)
candidates.unchecked: Any annual return duty; number of registered NGOs.

candidates.name: C8 Employer work-permit tracker for expatriate staff
candidates.trigger: Immigration regulations: permit to enter and reside (AUD 200 adult, AUD 20 extensions), authority to work for visitors
candidates.unchecked: Current fees (old consolidation); employer count. Very small.

candidates.existing: Government Falepili Mobility Pathway Support Service covers visa process and pre-departure support.
candidates.name: C9 Falepili Mobility Pathway annual ballot registration helper
candidates.trigger: Annual ballot window (2026-27 round ran 1 May to 1 June 2026; 280 places; AUD 25 fee; ImmiAccount), then visa application
candidates.unchecked: Whether migration-agent regulation in Australia restricts paid help; the ballot is free-to-use online. Not a duty on a business.

candidates.buyer: Biosecurity clearance agents and importers of food and plants
candidates.existing: Customs Tuvalu and Quarantine Office handle by paper; Tuvalu trade portal is the state's own site.
candidates.name: C10 Biosecurity clearance agent / importer permit helper
candidates.trigger: Biosecurity Act 2017 (Act No 24): import permits, quarantine, SPS certificates; permit fee AUD 10 (private importers AUD 2) per trade portal
candidates.unchecked: Whether clearance agents are actually licensed; regulations listing regulated goods not found.

candidates.evidence: https://tuvalufisheries.tv/2026/06/23/fisheries-management-regulations-2025/ (page does not give logbooks, fees or deadlines; PDF not read)
candidates.name: C12 Fisheries licence and logsheet compliance tool (already rejected)

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Labour and Employment Relations Act 2017 (PacLII laera2017332) applies to all employers/workplaces; written contracts, wage statements, employment records, record inspection. No domestic-worker-specific rule found. TNPF registration within 7 days of first employee (Provident Fund (Registration) Regulations) and monthly paper contribution returns. Tiny formal employer base. See C2.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Not searched. Atoll microstate (~11k people); no scrap-dealer licence class in the Licences Act schedules seen.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Not searched. Nothing seen in Licences Act schedules; market too small.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Not searched. No sign of a regulated activity; no gold sector.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Not searched. Few vehicles; Traffic Act Cap 50.10 licensing is by council area only (no dismantler regime seen).

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Not searched specifically (budget). Biosecurity Act 2017 governs animal imports; pig keeping is subsistence.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Not searched (budget). Nothing surfaced incidentally.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Not searched; no apiculture sector evident in a coral-atoll economy.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Pharmacy and Therapeutic Products Act 2016 applies in part to veterinary drugs, but no private vet practices surfaced. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Not searched; atolls use rainwater/desalination, government-run.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Not searched (budget).

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Not searched; essentially no lifts or boilers in the private sector.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Not searched; public/household rainwater tanks, government-run supply.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Not searched; negligible agriculture. Biosecurity Act covers imports.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Labour and Employment Relations Act 2017 ss9-10 regulate recruitment agents; STCW regs require private seafarer recruitment services to be licensed with compensation insurance; 2025 workshop on crew recruitment for Tuvalu-flagged seine vessels involved crewing agents (tuvalufisheries.tv). Feeds C1.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Not searched; burial is family/church/kaupule-run.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Incorporation of Non-Governmental Organizations Act (Cap 32.03) with a Registrar of NGOs and inspection powers; TANGO is the umbrella body. No evidence of annual-return duty or fee found. Weak (C7).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Traffic Act Cap 50.10 and Traffic Regulations (public service vehicles, taxis) licensed by council area; Lagoon Shipping Act 2022 requires certificate of seaworthiness, passenger limits and certificated officers for inter-island and lagoon trading vessels. Very few operators. Weak (C6).

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Licences Act Cap 26.24 (2010 amendment order schedules: hawker AUD 50, hairdresser/barber AUD 20, insurance agent AUD 500). Presumptive tax for turnover under 100k (Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2017). Weak (C3).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nothing surfaced in the Licences Act schedules or searches for these categories.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Petroleum Ordinance (1990 Rev. Cap 42) and Petroleum (Licence Fee) Regulations 1992 exist; storage thresholds. Fuel is a handful of government/state-linked importers. Nothing buildable.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Not searched; no commodity trading beyond small-scale copra. Copra search found no scheme documents.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Co-operative Societies Act (Cap 40.20, 2008 Rev.) with Registrar and Regulations on annual accounts, audit and an audit and supervision fund. Island co-op societies are very few and run in a handful of units. Weak (C4).

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Not searched specifically; health is state-run (Princess Margaret Hospital).

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacy and Therapeutic Products Act No 6 of 2016 (Cap 28.32 2022): pharmacy licence, import authorisation, Tuvalu Medicines Schedule. Pharmacy is government-run at the central medical store; no private pharmacy base found.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Crewing/manning agents and seafarer recruitment are the only live manpower sector (see C1).

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Not searched (budget). No mining; donor-funded construction handled by projects.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: One AML search returned only Vanuatu and Cook Islands material; no Tuvalu reporting-entity list or FIU found. Unverified. Land is customary, no broker market.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: No Tuvalu law or register for guest houses or accommodation found; Licences Act schedules seen do not list lodging. Handful of guest houses.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Biosecurity Act 2017 (Act No 24): import permits, biosecurity clearance agents, SPS certificates; permit fee AUD 10 (AUD 2 private importers) per trade portal. Fisheries Management Regulations 2025 on ALCs, permits, FAD reporting (known K01). Few importers; nothing new.

coverage.category: 31. Seafarer recruitment, certification and placement (Tuvalu seafarers on foreign ships)
coverage.found: STCW regs (Merchant Shipping), Ship Registry MLC circular MC 08/2012, TMTI trains ~120 cadets/yr; ADB noted inaccurate paper records of seafarer qualifications. No Tuvalu seafarer database found. See C1, C5.

coverage.category: 32. Provident fund (TNPF) employer registration and contributions
coverage.found: Provident Fund (Registration) and (Contributions) Regulations: register within 7 days of first employee, monthly contribution returns and payment statements with approved forms; no online employer portal found. Rate sources conflict (5 to 7.5%). See C2.

coverage.category: 33. Consumption tax and presumptive tax for small businesses
coverage.found: Consumption Tax Act 2008 (rate 3% from 1 July 2009 per regulations; quarterly period; registration threshold around 100k per an old form, unverified) and presumptive tax under 100k turnover. No online filing portal found. See C3.

coverage.category: 34. Foreign-worker permits and immigration (employers sponsoring expatriates)
coverage.found: Immigration regulations: permit to enter and reside AUD 200 adult, extension AUD 20, visitors need authority to work from non-government employers (AUD 10). Small numbers of employers. Weak (C8).

coverage.category: 35. Falepili Mobility Pathway visa ballot and applicant support
coverage.found: Annual ballot (2026-27 ballot 1 May to 1 June 2026, 280 places incl. dependants, AUD 25 fee, ImmiAccount); government Support Service already exists; no employer duty. Weak (C9).

coverage.category: 36. Fisheries sector: crew, observers, FAD users and local fishing operators
coverage.found: Fisheries Management Regulations 2025 (published 23 June 2026 on tuvalufisheries.tv): permits, ALCs, FAD monitoring and reporting, observer protections. Page does not mention exporters, processors, local agents or fees; full PDF not read. Known K01.
